title: Legislation
description: A law, ordinance, resolution, or a numbered part of a code.

@type.description: Always `Legislation` - the abstract work, not a file of it; the text itself lives in one or more `LegislationObject`s (see `encoding`). schema.org's legislation vocabulary derives from the European Legislation Identifier, so almost everything needed here already exists.

name.description: The law's short title, e.g. 'Noise Control Ordinance'.

description.description: A plain-language summary of what the law does.

url.description: Where this `Legislation`'s canonical human-readable page lives.

legislationIdentifier.description: The citation as the jurisdiction writes it - 'Ordinance 2025-15', 'Chapter 17.40', an ELI or CELEX URI.

codificationLevel.description: Which structural tier of a code this is. hasPart nests parts but never says what kind of part, which is the one gap in schema.org's legislation vocabulary.

position.description: Ordering among siblings. Real schema.org `CreativeWork` property.

legislationResponsible.description: The `GovernmentOrganization` that administers or enforces it, when different from the body that passed it.

enactedAt.description: The `Meeting` at which it was adopted. This is the join to the meetings profile, and the reason the two are built together.

legislationDateOfApplicability.description: When it becomes applicable, which can differ from entry into force.

legislationDateVersion.description: The point in time this description of the legislation is valid for. This is how consolidated codes express versioning, and the hardest part of publishing a municipal code correctly.

legislationLegalForce.description: Real schema.org property with a real enumeration. Do not invent a status field.

dateModified.description: When this record was last updated - not when the law itself changed; see `legislationDateVersion` for that.

temporalCoverage.description: The period the law applies to, when it isn't open-ended.

inLanguage.description: The language(s) the text is authoritative in.

isPartOf.description: The parent tier: a section's chapter, a chapter's title.

hasPart.description: The next tier down: a chapter's sections, a title's chapters.

legislationChanges.description: The general effect this has on another `Legislation`, when `legislationAmends`/`legislationRepeals` aren't specific enough.

legislationConsolidates.description: The prior versions this consolidated text supersedes.

legislationCorrects.description: The `Legislation` this issues a correction to.

encoding.description: The actual files. Attach the Akoma Ntoso XML here. Structural markup inside the text (clauses, provisos, amendment instructions) is out of scope by design - that's what Akoma Ntoso is for.

keywords.description: Subject keywords. Not `schema:about`, which ranges over `Thing` and is for references to entities - free-text strings there expand as relative IRIs.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
